policy: Third-party widgets are retained as the original public embed. Their private application code was not copied or reimplemented.

honeybook.function: Contact page inquiry embed inside a Squarespace embed block.
honeybook.submission: Not tested. No inquiry was sent.
honeybook.dependency: Requires HoneyBook widget servers at view time. Domain allowlisting is unresolved until a browser render check.

google.dependency: Google tag endpoints. Collection was not exercised as a conversion and is not required for page content.

embedly_note: Video items carry Squarespace VideoEmbed data-config-embed-video with an Embedly iframe around YouTube. The Embedly key present in that public HTML is retained in the page; it is public page configuration, not a newly issued credential.
squarespace_runtime: Visitor JS remains loaded from assets.squarespace.com, definitions.sqspcdn.com, and static1.squarespace.com. Archival copies are under capture/platform-js and are not served as the site runtime. Squarespace retains copyright in those files.

soundcloud.share_tokens: Each live iframe already contains a SoundCloud share token. The token stays inside that iframe and is not copied into this inventory.
soundcloud.render: The quartet player drew its waveform in the local browser. Playback was not started.
soundcloud.dependency: Requires w.soundcloud.com and api.soundcloud.com at view time.

calendly_note: The social profile string published in the page JSON is https://calendly.com/sunsetstrings, including the trailing comma. It was not corrected.
